title: Scratch adoptions pollute the host registry of adopted repositories
body:
Source: S29 rehearsal 2026-11-16, krn adopt on a scratch clone of boilerplate-2026 main 2fb16ac (logs .krn/tmp/s29/adopt2.log, t1.log post-adopt suite, t26.log pristine suite under the pinned Node 26: 62 pass, 2 fail only from an untrusted mise config in a temp dir).
~/.krn/adopted.json lists 20 entries, all scratch clones under /mnt/storage/tmp (the S29 rehearsal clone was removed by hand). The metric real-adopted-repos and krn adopt --refresh-all read it.
Outcome: adopt registers a repo only when it is not under a temp directory or KRN's .krn/tmp, or --register is passed; a prune drops temp paths.
Proof: node --test test/brain/adopted-registry.test.ts: pass.
